# Lab and Demo Engineering

Use for a learner lab, instructor demo, guided exercise, or a course environment with Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure, or GitHub.

Specify objective, audience, duration, prerequisites, accounts, licenses, roles, permissions, data, setup, exact steps, checkpoints, expected result, cleanup, and evidence. Dry-run in a clean environment and record what was actually tested. Make each action idempotent where practical and provide a checkpoint before any destructive or costly step. Include common UI variance, throttling, sign-in, consent, and permission failures. Offer a static walkthrough or screenshots when live access is unavailable.
